subject.title: fix: fall back after replay-safe Bedrock prompt aborts

question: Should this PR require a redacted real Bedrock/provider abort-to-fallback trace, or may it merge with the focused regression coverage and negative live Bedrock attempts as sufficient evidence?
rationale: The exact provider-originated abort envelope did not reproduce in the contributor’s available AWS environment, so automated review cannot establish that the production failure reaches the new predicate without replay risk.

options.title: Require exact abort-to-fallback proof
options.body: Keep the merge gate until a redacted after-fix trace shows replay-safe classification, fallback selection, and successful completion for the provider abort envelope.

options.title: Accept a documented proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept the source-level tests and negative live Bedrock attempts despite the missing production-envelope trace.

recommendation.title: Require exact abort-to-fallback proof
recommendation.body: Keep the merge gate until a redacted after-fix trace shows replay-safe classification, fallback selection, and successful completion for the provider abort envelope.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged replay-safe prompt-fallback policy and are the strongest available policy-history routing candidate.
